# `scene.set_origin`: Set origin

Moves an object's origin (pivot) without moving its geometry in the world.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(V) of the mesh plus O(children)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: set pivot, origin to geometry, center pivot, affect pivot only

Game assets usually want the origin at the bottom center (props) or a corner (modular pieces, `to: bbox` with `bbox: [0, 0, 0]`). Vertices shift the other way and children keep their world positions.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | `[number, number, number]` | `[0.5,0.0,0.5]` | For `bbox`: fractions of the bounding box per axis (0 is the minimum, 1 the maximum). For a modular wall's corner pivot: [0, 0, 0]. |
| `point` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | For `point`: the new origin in object space. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |
| `to` | `OriginMode` | `"bottom_center"` | Where to put the origin: `bottom_center` (default), `center`, `bbox` or `point`. |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"crate","to":"center"}
```

Result: `origin of crate (o:1) moved by 0 0.3 0 m`
